title: Initial Evaluator Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. The evaluator configuration formed from the initial configuration of $M$ on $s$, with true boundary tag and physical input-head position $1$, equals the configuration on physical input $w$ whose initial evaluator state is active, whose first work tape stores $s$, and whose other work tapes are blank.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Boolean Turing machine
w and s are Boolean words
replaced:
For every physical input $w$ and argument word $s$, the evaluator configuration built
from the initial configuration of $M$ on $s$, with initial tag and physical input head
at one, equals the canonical seam configuration of the capture-wrapped evaluator whose
first work tape holds $s$, all other work tapes blank, all heads at their origins, and
output empty.
